# NaufalRF Anonymous Message App — Full LLM Context

## Overview

This SvelteKit app provides the anonymous-message experience for the portfolio ecosystem. It is intentionally narrow: one form-driven surface, Turnstile-protected delivery, same-origin analytics, and no direct persistence or admin logic in the app itself.

## Core responsibilities

- Render the anonymous message form and submission states.
- Enforce Turnstile validation before allowing submission.
- Forward accepted submissions to Admin public APIs.
- Track pageviews and submission-related interactions through a same-origin analytics proxy.

## Architecture

- Framework: SvelteKit 2.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4 and the same light-neumorphic design family as the rest of the portfolio.
- Submission boundary: browser form -> SvelteKit action in `src/routes/+page.server.ts` -> Admin public API.
- Analytics boundary: browser -> `src/routes/api/analytics/+server.ts` -> Admin analytics endpoint.

## Key files

- `src/routes/+page.svelte` — main anonymous message UI, Turnstile mounting, analytics events.
- `src/routes/+page.server.ts` — form action and server-side submission proxy.
- `src/routes/api/analytics/+server.ts` — same-origin analytics proxy.
- `src/lib/api.ts` — Admin-facing submission helper.

## Constraints

- Never bypass Turnstile when it is configured.
- Never bypass Admin APIs for persistence.
- Keep the app focused and anonymous; it is not a general chat or contact surface.
